speaker: Doctor
text: I see you're experiencing shortness of breath and have noticed your abdomen has increased in size. Can you tell me more about the large ovarian mass that was found?

speaker: Patient
text: I wasn't aware there was a mass; I just noticed my belly getting bigger and felt out of breath. I don't have any pain, but I do feel very tired lately. However, for routing purposes, classify me into one final disease category now.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given the combination of a large ovarian mass, ascites causing increased abdominal girth, and shortness of breath likely due to pleural effusion, this presentation is highly suggestive of Meigs' syndrome. DIAGNOSIS READY: Meigs' syndrome
